[Story]
Xiaoling's store faces closure. She knows that the nearby merchant, Xiaozhou, wants to expand, so she plans to convince Xiaozhou to buy her store at a lower price.

[Question]
How does Xiaoling convince Xiaozhou?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Xiaoling can offer a period of free consultation or coaching to ensure a smooth transition of the business.
B. Xiaoling can promise not to open competitive businesses in the area for a certain period of time.
C. Xiaoling can make some suggestions about store renovation and upgrade, showing the potential possibilities of the store.
D. Xiaoling can show Xiaozhou the turnover and customer flow data of her store, proving its potential value.
